meta.title: Schoolive - Virtual Streamer Society
meta.description: Schoolive is a virtual streamer society founded in 2019 to create media works, public lectures, and a positive virtual world.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: Founded in 2019, Schoolive aimed to create outstanding media works in all forms. We not only produce entertainment-oriented content, but also deliver public academic lectures in a creative and interesting way. It is our goal to share knowledge to the public and bring positive impact to the society via building an attractive virtual world.
